title: #86 Digital Materials
prompt: With the increase of digital media available online, the role of the library has become obsolete. Universities should only procure new digital media rather than constantly update textbooks. Discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this position and give your own point of view.

promptSegments.text: With the increase of digital media available online, the role of the library has become obsolete.
Universities should only procure new digital media rather than constantly update textbooks.
Discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this position and give your own point of view.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
Đưa ra nhận định tổng thể theo yêu cầu.

requirements.en: Support the comparison with relevant examples.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph argues that libraries are becoming obsolete because digital materials are more convenient and accessible.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph argues that libraries are becoming obsolete because digital materials are more convenient and accessible.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph discusses the opposing view, arguing that physical libraries still provide a necessary quiet space for students.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph discusses the opposing view, arguing that physical libraries still provide a necessary quiet space for students.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Libraries provide a physical space for learning, offering more than just digital files.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Libraries provide a physical space for learning, offering more than just digital files.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Libraries must keep their collection of printed materials current, as digital media cannot replace the feel of printed pages.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Libraries must keep their collection of printed materials current, as digital media cannot replace the feel of printed pages.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Digital media provides instant and flexible access to a wide range of academic information for students.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital media provides instant and flexible access to a wide range of academic information for students.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Digital resources are superior to physical books because they can be updated quickly and accurately.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital resources are superior to physical books because they can be updated quickly and accurately.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Libraries provide essential physical spaces and collections that digital formats cannot fully replace, supporting the view that they are still relevant.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Libraries provide essential physical spaces and collections that digital formats cannot fully replace, supporting the view that they are still relevant.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Universities still need to update their physical textbooks and resources because many academic subjects require hands-on interaction with physical materials.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Universities still need to update their physical textbooks and resources because many academic subjects require hands-on interaction with physical materials.
